title: Uyyala Jampala
desc: When Suri learns that his cousin Uma is seeing someone, he decides to investigate and learns that the guy is a fraud. When Uma elopes with the boy, Suri tracks her down and tries to expose her lover.

title: Bhale Bhale Magadivoy
desc: Lucky, an amnesiac scientist, is in love with Nandana, who is unaware of his condition. Things take a turn when he has to convince her parents for their marriage.

title: Balagam
desc: A young man in severe debt believes that the only way to pay it off is through the dowry from his impending marriage. However, the death of his grandfather puts his plan on hold.

title: Skanda: The Attacker
desc: After Rayudu and Ranjith Reddy's children elope, the CMs turn against each other. However, when a college student kidnaps Reddy's daughter, a revenge saga unravels.

title: K-Ramp
desc: A rich businessman, Krishna, sends his wayward son, Kumar, to Kerala in order to reform him. There, Kumar falls for Mercy, a girl with PTSD and suicidal tendencies.

title: Parugu
desc: A rich and powerful Neelakanta's perception about love marriage changes when both his daughters, Subbalakshmi and Meenakshi, fall in love.

title: Kushi
desc: Two college friends who help their classmates unite, fall in love with each other but soon, a small misunderstanding causes a rift between them.

title: Por Thozhil
desc: With limited evidence in a race against time, two police officers must combine their skills and experience to arrest a psychopath targeting women.

title: Fun Time
desc: The programme includes comedy clips from Tollywood movies.

title: Raju Gari Gadhi
desc: Seven young contestants take part in a reality TV show. They spend a week inside a haunted house and soon witness paranormal activities around them.

title: Entha Manchivaadavuraa
desc: Balu grows up without the love of a family due to his parents' untimely death. Later, he decides to establish a firm to help people like himself receive the affection they missed out on.

title: Mrithyunjay
desc: An aspiring crime reporter becomes suspicious when a death is ruled as accidental. Soon, when he investigates, he encounters a complex web of deception and danger.

title: Julayi
desc: When Ravi unknowingly thwarts Bittu's bank heist, he becomes the target of Bittu's wrath. Subsequently, Ravi is forced to fight to protect his loved ones from the ruthless criminal.

title: Nuvvu Naaku Nachav
desc: Venky, an unemployed youth, heads to Hyderabad for a marriage ceremony. What seems like a brief vacation gradually turns into something more, when the soon-to-be bride falls for him.

title: Shubham
desc: Married men unite when their wives obsess over a cable soap opera, planning activities to cope, reflect, and reclaim family time while navigating friendship and temptation.
